# Source Tree

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SourceTree`](gmeow-SourceTree.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SourceTree>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

A content-addressed directory tree of source code — the recursive Merkle structure that represents a snapshot of a project's files and subdirectories at a point in time. Aligned to Software Heritage Directory and git tree objects by reference.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:SourceNode`](gmeow-SourceNode.md)

Use [`gmeow:SourceTree`](gmeow-SourceTree.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:SourceNode`](gmeow-SourceNode.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
